geeklist.title: 2025 Downsizing Auction - Ends 11/1/25
geeklist.description:
[b]Auction Rules[/b]
[size=24][b]AUCTION CLOSED @ 10:31pm EST 10/31/25[/b][/size]
[b]1. End Time:[/b] The auction will end on Saturday 11/01/2025, sometime between 8:00pm and 11:59pm EST.
[b]2. Condition:[/b] - New = In shrink - Like New = Opened, played once or less - Very Good = Lightly played, but no wear - Good = Shows some wear - Acceptable = Shows significant wear ***Games in any condition may not have original inserts and none will have slipcases or non-English language rulebooks.***
[b]3. Bidding:[/b] Most items have a starting bid. Bids lower than the starting bid will not be considered. All bids must be in whole dollar increments. All items have the current price from Miniature Market (if available) or purchase price from Kickstarter for reference. Purchasing multiple items will not result in a price reduction and I will not lower any prices, so please refrain from asking.
[b]4. BINS:[/b] All items have a BIN price. The first BIN offer will win the item. Backup BINs are acceptable and will be taken in order received.
[b]5. Payment:[/b] All purchases must be made through BGG within 3 days of the end of the auction. All payments must be through Paypal. Items not purchased/paid for within the limits will be cancelled.
[b]6. Shipping:[/b] The buyer is responsible for paying shipping costs. I will be shipping via USPS Priority Mail from Syracuse, NY. I utilize PirateShip to help lower shipping costs. All games will be shipped at the end of the auction. Combined shipping is available for multi-win items and may not ship Flat Rate due to size. As I do not have all packaging materials at this time, cost estimates for games that do not fit in Flat Rate boxes or combined shipping are not available. US shipping addresses only.
